# BurnerSOL

## Site Information
- URL: https://www.burnersol.com
- Description: Non-custodial Solana wallet cleaner that recovers locked SOL from unused token accounts, closes empty SPL accounts, removes spam NFTs, and reclaims wallet rent deposits.
- Type: DeFi / Web3 Application

## Core Features
- SOL rent recovery from unused token accounts
- Close empty SPL and Token-2022 accounts
- Remove spam NFTs from wallets
- Non-custodial - never accesses private keys
- Works with Phantom, Solflare, Backpack, and all Solana wallets

## Technical Details
- Built on Solana blockchain
- Uses SPL Token and Token-2022 standards
- RPC providers: Alchemy, Helius
- Instant state rent recovery (~0.00203 SOL per account)

## Supported Wallets
- Phantom
- Solflare
- Backpack
- All wallets using Solana wallet adapter standard

## How to Use
1. Connect your Solana wallet
2. BurnerSOL scans for empty/unused token accounts
3. Select accounts to close
4. Confirm transaction - rent is returned to your wallet
